HSBC chief economist for Australia and New Zealand, [Paul Bloxham](http://www.theaustralian.com.au/business/monthly-measure-of-inflation-needed/story-e6frg8zx-1225933517558 "Paul Bloxham"), makes the case for a monthly CPI. I made related arguments in this op-ed in [The Canberra Times](../../files/ctoped1mar10.pdf "The Canberra Times") in March.
